```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Neoliberal policies have given rise to an economic order of frequent crises and mass unemployment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over one in five families in Ferguson live below the poverty line.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberal policies disproportionately affect communities of color, with unemployment rates running 2-3 times those of white Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Institutionalized white supremacy is a clear legacy of the unemployment rate disparity between communities of color and white Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Neoliberal policies support cuts in job programs, education and civilian review boards, but not police weaponry.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The neoliberal state disinvests in people, but heavily invests in prisons, police repression and militarism abroad.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The level of para-military police force in Ferguson is unprecedented for the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Tanks, battle armor and mounted semi-automatic weapons are present in the streets of Ferguson.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America’s imperial ambitions abroad are reflected in the weapons channeled from surplus war equipment to local police departments through Department of Homeland Security grants.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists abhor the logic that allows local police departments to transform themselves into surrogate occupying armies defending “social order” against popular demands for social justice.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes in fighting for an equitable tax system that would fund public investment and job training.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Public investment and job training could employ the underemployed and unemployed in alternative energy production and the rebuilding of infrastructure and affordable housing.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Independent civilian review boards, with adequate funding and power, should oversee a local police force.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A local police force should be well-trained and representative of the communities they serve.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
